newsitem.title: USA: FUND AMERICAN, STATE FARM INVEST IN SYNDICATE.
newsitem.headline: FUND AMERICAN, STATE FARM INVEST IN SYNDICATE.

text.p: A group of strategic investors led by Fund American Enterprises Holdings Inc and State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Co will acquire a significant minority interest in Lloyd's syndicate Murray Lawrence Holdings Ltd, Fund American and State Farm said.

The investment is part of a transaction that will inject Murray Lawrence with 40 million stg of fresh capital to support the development of Syndicate 2001 and the group's insurance services businesses, Fund American said.
The transaction is subject to Murray Lawrence shareholder and Lloyd's approval, Fund American said.
Fund American and State Farm said they will provide 85 percent of the cash injection in the transaction, which represents their first investment in the Lloyd's market.

"Our strategy is to invest in successful insurance businesses and we believe that our partnership with State Farm and Murray Lawrence will help its development at an interesting stage in Lloyd's history," Fund American chairman Jack Byrne said.
"We have already build an excellent working relationship with the company's executives and we look forward to a long and rewarding relationship," he said.
Fund American's investment will be made at White Mountains Holdings, the company's Hanover, New Hampshire-based operating enterprise.
